summary: Phase 3 (Stripe billing CAD) and Phase 5 (AI cold-calling sales) tested end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_sales_billing.py (37 new tests) → combined with existing backend_test.py: 81/81 pytest passing. Frontend: owner Billing panel renders current trial plan + Starter($49)/Growth($99) cards + invoice list; subscribe-starter correctly redirects to Stripe Checkout (test mode) at checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...; /payment/cancel renders payment-cancelled; sms-pack-card correctly hidden until subscription exists; owner has no 'AI Sales' nav link and /sales URL redirects to dashboard. Admin Plans tab: 3 plans (starter/growth/pack) with amount inputs; changing Growth $99 → $109, Save shows toast 'Plan saved and synced to Stripe', input reflects 109; restored to 99 cleanly. Admin Integrations tab lists all 6 new keys (VAPI_API_KEY, VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, VAPI_WEBHOOK_SECRET, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID, BILLING_GRACE_DAYS). AI Sales page (superadmin): 4 analytics cards + 7-stage Kanban (new/contacted/interested/demo_booked/won/lost/do_not_call); CSV import toast 'Imported 3 · 0 duplicates · 0 DNC-suppressed · 0 errors'; prospect sheet opens on card click; simulate-call with opt-out transcript → GPT summary rendered, stage history 'new → do_not_call · ai-caller', stage-select hidden, DNC pill shown; Campaigns tab 'Start' triggers expected 503 toast 'Vapi is not configured yet'; Script tab bad opening (missing 'RevLoop'/'record') returns 400 toast; DNC tab Export CSV anchor points to /api/sales/calls/export. Backend: webhook rejects bad Stripe signature (400) and bad Vapi secret (403); staff gets 403 on /api/billing and /api/billing/checkout; owner gets 403 on all 6 /api/sales/* routes; checkout plan='pack' without subscription returns 400 as specified; unknown plan returns 404; Growth plan put/restore cycle syncs Stripe price IDs. Simulate-call with demo-booking transcript → outcome=demo_booked and stage advances; opt-out transcript → outcome=do_not_call, dnc=true, phone added to DNC list, further stage POST returns 400 (permanent).

ui_bugs.issue: Radix DialogContent is missing a DialogTitle, causing an accessibility console warning: '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Visible as business_name h2 but needs to be semantically wired as the title (or wrapped with VisuallyHidden).

action_items: (Low) Wrap the Sales prospect-sheet business_name heading as a proper SheetTitle/DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to silence the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py checkout logic cleanly enforces 'pack requires existing subscription' and 'can't double-subscribe' invariants, verified by pytest.
sales.py set_stage correctly rejects stage changes once in do_not_call ('Do-not-call is permanent.') — verified end-to-end via simulate-call and manual POST.
sales.summarize() uses regex fallback for non-JSON GPT output and forces outcome='do_not_call' when opt-out phrases are detected; a nice belt-and-suspenders implementation.
In-batch duplicate detection in /sales/prospects/import works because 'have' set is mutated per row — behavior differs from CSV CRM import; worth documenting but not broken.

sync_price() uses the lookup_key + metadata.emergent_product_id pattern correctly; price change on Growth creates a new price id and marks the old one inactive. Confirmed via admin UI roundtrip 99→109→99.
ADMIN /admin/plans endpoint returns stripe_price_id — frontend should ideally display it; currently not shown in Admin.tsx plan card (minor UX nit).
